items.feature: Sidebar entry that returns to Home, plus a keyboard command to go Home
items.why: Sidebar Home row (Sidebar.tsx) and the nav.home binding, handled in src/palette/PaletteHost.tsx (go-home) through the keybinding dispatcher.

items.feature: Sidebar top bar with a sidebar toggle button and back/forward history arrows
items.why: No in-sidebar toggle button (toggle is keyboard-only, plus a Home button when hidden) and no back/forward navigation; the reference shows all three at the top of the sidebar.

items.feature: Computer/account switcher at the top of the sidebar (initial avatar, name, chevron)
items.why: Sidebar starts with our logo and name; the reference starts with a computer/account switcher.

items.feature: Primary nav rows Home, Create and Search above the workspace list
items.why: Home and 'New workspace' rows (Sidebar.tsx); no Search row. The reference labels the second row Create.

items.feature: Workspaces listed under their repository, repositories as collapsible groups
items.why: Repos render as collapsible groups with nested workspace rows (Sidebar.tsx, store toggleRepo).

items.feature: Workspace list grouped under a sentence-case 'my workspaces' label rather than an uppercase repositories header
items.why: We show an uppercase 'Repositories' header with a '+'; the reference shows a sentence-case 'my workspaces' label.

items.feature: Manual, persisted ordering of repositories
items.why: crates/openconductor-db/src/repos.rs lists repos by display_order, created_at and appends new ones at the end, but the app does not depend on that crate and the sidebar renders insertion order from localStorage.

items.feature: Hide and unhide a repository, with a toggle to show hidden ones
items.why: crates/openconductor-db repos::set_hidden and find_reusable_hidden (tested), but the app does not depend on that crate; no hide/unhide UI.

items.feature: Per-repository icon (icon, emoji, favicon or uploaded image) next to the repo name
items.why: crates/openconductor-db repos::set_icon (tested); not linked into the app and no icon UI.

items.feature: Add-repository control reachable from the sidebar
items.why: Sidebar '+' runs the Open-project flow in App.tsx: native folder picker, inspect_project_folder, add_repository, then the row is added with the backend's default branch.

items.feature: Workspace row shows the workspace name, distinguishing user-set from generated names
items.why: Row shows the name; user_set_workspace_name / user_set_branch_name are now modelled (src/state/types.ts) but no user rename sets them, and rows show a name where the reference shows the branch-style title.

items.feature: Workspace branch visible from the sidebar row
items.why: Branch appears only in the row tooltip.

items.feature: Status indicator from a derived status with optional manual override (default in-progress)
items.why: Status dot uses our own idle/working/needs-review/archived model, not derived/manual status with in-progress default (src/state/types.ts).

items.feature: Line additions/deletions on each row, colored, with a setting to color unselected rows
items.why: +/- counts render from stored placeholder numbers; not computed from git, no colour setting.

items.feature: Unread marker, mark-as-unread action and jump-to-next-unread command
items.why: crates/openconductor-db workspaces::set_unread (tested); crate not linked into the app; no unread styling or next-unread command.

items.feature: Pin workspaces into a pinned group at the top
items.why: crates/openconductor-db workspaces::set_pinned_at (tested); crate not linked into the app; no pinned group or pin action.

items.feature: User navigation sections: create, rename, delete, emoji; move a workspace into or out of a section
items.why: No sections UI or commands; navigation_sections only in crates/openconductor-db/migrations/0005_navigation_and_favorites.sql (unwired).

items.feature: Drag a workspace row onto a section
items.why: No drag and drop.

items.feature: Workspace numbers shown optionally, with Cmd+1..9 switching
items.why: workspace.switchTo1..9 are handled in PaletteHost.tsx over sidebarOrder (fromAppState.ts); rows never show numbers and there is no setting to show them.

items.feature: Next/previous workspace commands
items.why: workspace.next / workspace.previous handled in PaletteHost.tsx via stepWorkspace (wraps, sidebar order; tested in fromAppState.test.ts).

items.feature: Search/filter workspaces
items.why: Workspaces are searchable from the command palette (src/palette/search/model.ts, Cmd+K) by name, branch and repo; the sidebar has no Search row to reach it.

items.feature: Rename a workspace (local only), optionally also renaming the branch
items.why: rename_workspace_branch command (src-tauri workspace) and the automatic first-message rename call it; no user-facing rename action.

items.feature: Archive with confirmation, refusing while a git operation is in progress, recording an archive commit
items.why: Archive from WorkspaceView and the palette (workspace.archive) only removes the localStorage row: no confirmation, no git-busy check, no call to WorkspaceManager::archive.

items.feature: Browse archived workspaces and unarchive one
items.why: WorkspaceManager::restore exists (src-tauri/src/workspace/mod.rs); no command, no UI.

items.feature: Resizable sidebar and show/hide toggles for left and right sidebars
items.why: Toggle works via Cmd+B and '[' (src/state/shortcuts.ts, App.tsx); the sidebar is a fixed 248px column with no resize.

items.feature: Optional CPU/memory usage readout in the sidebar footer
items.why: Footer shows app name/version only.

items.feature: Sidebar footer with help and settings icon buttons
items.why: Footer shows app name, version and platform text; the reference shows help and settings icon buttons.

items.feature: Sidebar transparency (vibrancy) setting
items.why: No vibrancy/transparency.

items.feature: Sidebar background, border and width match the reference screens in light and dark
items.why: Measured on REA captures at 1440x900: sidebar edge at x=248 vs 256; dark sidebar #121417 vs #1c1817; light sidebar #eeeeeb vs #fcfcfb. REA compare-web-screenshots (threshold 24): 3.1% (dark) / 5.4% (light) of sidebar pixels differ.

items.feature: Workspace actions menu on a row (copy info, rename, archive, pin, section)
items.why: No row context menu or actions menu.

items.feature: Empty state when there are no repositories or workspaces
items.why: Muted single-line empty state matches evidence/screens/home.md.

items.feature: Sidebar add menu offering the three Home actions plus recent local repositories not yet added (spinner while loading)
items.why: '+' goes straight to the folder picker; no menu with the three Home actions and no recents (the detector hit is QuickOpen's recent files).

items.feature: Left sidebar visibility and width persisted as settings (default visible, width 256)
items.why: Visibility persists inside the localStorage app state, not as a setting; width is fixed (248px vs evidence default 256).

items.feature: Home is the root route and the default screen
items.why: Home is the default screen, but there is no router or '/' route (selection state in src/state/store.ts).

items.feature: Home renders nothing while the organization loads and redirects a cloud organization to all-workspaces
items.why: No organization concept; no loading or cloud redirect state.

items.feature: Centered wordmark (light/dark variants) above three label-only entry cards in a 1-to-3 column grid, whole area a window drag region
items.why: Matches evidence/screens: three label-only cards in a 1-to-3 grid sit at the reference position (y 368-495; x offset 4 px from the narrower sidebar), wordmark centered above, drag region, fade-in. Differences: card icons for GitHub (cloud vs globe) and Quick start (sparkle vs folder-plus); the wordmark is our own brand by design.

items.feature: Home background and entry-card fill match the reference screens in light and dark
items.why: Measured: dark main #17191d vs #141110, dark card #24272d vs #211e1c; light main #f7f7f5 vs #ffffff, light card #efefec vs #fafaf9. Every pixel differs at threshold 0 (REA compare-web-screenshots).

items.feature: When the left sidebar is hidden, Home shows a toggle button with its shortcut, offset past the traffic lights
items.why: Toggle shown only when the sidebar is hidden, with tooltip and shortcut hint (HomeScreen.tsx).

items.feature: Add an existing local repository via a folder picker, with default-branch detection
items.why: Open project card: native picker, inspect_project_folder (src-tauri/src/project.rs), add_repository; default branch comes from the backend.

items.feature: Open project: folder picker; no .git leads to an add dialog that offers git init; a missing origin (non-GitHub setting off) leads to the same dialog; otherwise add with a file:// remote; errors in a toast
items.why: Folder checks and decision are real (project.rs, src/state/openProject.ts with tests): file:// remote on success and error toasts. The no-.git / no-origin cases only show an info toast; the init / create-GitHub-repo dialog is not built.

items.feature: Clone a GitHub repository by URL into a chosen folder, with progress
items.why: Dialog parses GitHub URLs but performs no clone and has no destination picker or progress.

items.feature: Create a new project: local folder, git init, optional private GitHub repo, then a first workspace
items.why: Quick start dialog with placeholder templates; no git init, no GitHub repo, no first workspace on disk.

items.feature: Refuse adding a repository that is already added
items.why: Store silently ignores a duplicate path/remote; no already-exists message. Backend add_repository returns the existing id.

items.feature: Home explains that a repository must be added before creating a workspace
items.why: With no repository the create dialog explains that a repository is needed and offers Add repository (CreateWorkspaceDialog.tsx).

items.feature: Home shows workspaces with their status (status matrix option, mine vs all)
items.why: Home shows no workspace list or statuses.

items.feature: Dashboard and all-workspaces routes
items.why: No /dashboard or /all-workspaces screens.

items.feature: Recent workspaces list
items.why: The command palette keeps a most-recent-first list of visited workspaces (PaletteHost.tsx, in memory only); Home shows no recents.

items.feature: Search the repository list
items.why: No repository search.

items.feature: Clone dialog shows recent repositories with loading placeholders and a screen-reader status
items.why: Clone dialog has no recent repositories (detector hit is CreateFromPicker's status line).

items.feature: First-run onboarding route before Home
items.why: No onboarding.

items.feature: Repositories and workspaces persist in SQLite (conductor.db shape), surviving restart
items.why: UI state lives in localStorage; backend keeps a TSV repo registry; the Conductor-shaped SQLite schema in crates/openconductor-db is not used by the app.

items.feature: Create-workspace action per repository (sidebar and Home)
items.why: Cmd+N, the sidebar 'New workspace' row, each repo's '+' and the palette action all open the create dialog (App.tsx, Sidebar.tsx, PaletteHost.tsx).

items.feature: Full-screen create-workspace page with its own composer and tab navigation
items.why: Create is a modal form (CreateWorkspaceDialog.tsx) with a prompt box, repo and branch selects and a name field. The reference is a composer: repo chip, prompt, model/effort picker and Create button (REA compare at t=24: 7.6% dark, 89% light differ).

items.feature: Create a workspace from a PR, branch or issue
items.why: Create-from picker with PR, branch and issue tabs (CreateFromPicker.tsx, createFrom.ts); branches come from list_branches, but PRs and issues report unavailable in the desktop app (no GitHub/Linear listing command).

items.feature: Choose the base branch new workspaces branch from; remember the intended target branch
items.why: Base-branch select fed by list_branches, defaulting to the repo default branch; passed to create_workspace.

items.feature: Branch picker with search, loading, empty and error states
items.why: Branch tab in the create-from picker with search, loading, empty and error states over list_branches (CreateFromPicker.tsx, createFrom.ts statusLine).

items.feature: Each workspace is a git worktree on its own branch in a configurable workspaces directory
items.why: The dialog calls create_workspace, which runs git worktree add on its own branch under the data dir (src-tauri/src/workspace/mod.rs).

items.feature: Branch name prefix setting (none, user-based or custom)
items.why: resolveBranchPrefix is applied in the dialog, but App.tsx passes empty prefix settings and no GitHub username, so the prefix is always none; no settings UI.

items.feature: Generated placeholder name/branch, replaced when the agent names the branch (rename-on-branch setting)
items.why: City-name placeholder with rarity badge (naming.ts) in the dialog; after the first message renameAfterFirstMessage renames workspace and branch via rename_workspace_branch.

items.feature: Validate workspace names and branch names before creating
items.why: buildCreateRequest validates name, repo, base branch and source and shows field errors; create_workspace rejects invalid branch names (git.rs).

items.feature: Copy ignored files (worktreeinclude / include globs / .env*) into each new workspace
items.why: create_workspace copies .worktreeinclude / globs / .env* files (files_to_copy.rs), now reached from the dialog.

items.feature: Run the repository setup script on creation and keep its log
items.why: The dialog reports no setup script; create_workspace never runs one. WorkspaceManager::run_setup and crates/scripts setup lifecycle exist but are not called (crates/scripts is not an app dependency).

items.feature: Initializing state with progress while the workspace is created
items.why: The dialog shows createFlow progress (creating, failed) while create_workspace runs; there is no initializing workspace row or view, and setup steps are skipped.

items.feature: Creation failure surfaced with logs; incomplete workspaces cleaned up on start
items.why: Failure text is shown in the dialog; no setup log, and no startup cleanup of incomplete workspaces (workspaces::delete_if_initializing exists only in the unlinked DB crate).

items.feature: Create a workspace directly inside a sidebar section
items.why: No sections.

items.feature: Draft the first agent message, then create the workspace and send it
items.why: The first message seeds the workspace transcript and drives the rename (CreateWorkspaceDialog.tsx, firstMessage.ts); no agent session is started.

items.feature: Assign a per-workspace number on creation
items.why: No workspace numbers.

items.feature: Optionally start the run script automatically after setup
items.why: crates/scripts runner::should_auto_run (tested) decides auto-run after setup, but setup never runs on create and the crate is not an app dependency.
